title: AskUserQuestion Shape Schema
description: Schema for .claude/metadata/ask-question-shape.json — the limits and correction text .claude/hooks/ask-question-shape-hook.js applies to every AskUserQuestion call (#3233). The hook fails open: absent or malformed data means no block.

_meta.description: Human-facing provenance. Never read by the hook.

maxQuestionLength.description: Longest question text, in characters, the hook lets through. A convention threshold: one sentence.

maxOptions.description: The tool's own limit on options per question (#3198).

maxHeaderLength.description: The tool's own limit on header length, in characters (#3198).

multiSelect.description: Must not suggest previews: the tool renders them for single-select questions only.

convention.description: Lines appended to every correction: the context-table format and its companions, which the hook cannot check because it never sees text printed before the call.
